# JimmyAI API Documentation

> JimmyAI is a unified OpenAI-compatible API gateway for image and video generation. Base URL: https://api.viraltok.ai. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. Most video and image tasks are async — create a task, then poll the query endpoint for status and results. Docs site: https://docs.viraltok.ai

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/index.md): Get your API key, recharge your account, and send your first video generation request.
- [Development Guide](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/development.md): Integration patterns and best practices for building with the JimmyAI API.
- [快速入门](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/index.md): 获取 API 密钥、充值账户并发送首个视频生成请求。
- [开发指南](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/development.md): 在应用程序中集成 JimmyAI API 的指南。

## FAQ

- [FAQ](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/faq.md): Frequently asked questions about billing, authentication, and API usage.
- [常见问题](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/faq.md): 有关计费、认证和 API 使用的常见问题解答。

## API Reference

- [Introduction](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/introduction.md): Overview of JimmyAI API capabilities — VEO, Gemini Omni, Seedance, Wan, and GPT Image models.
- [介绍](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/introduction.md): JimmyAI API 能力概览 — VEO、Gemini Omni、Seedance、Wan 及 GPT Image 模型。

### Common

- [Query Video Task](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/common/query.md): Query the status and result of a video generation task.
- [Query Image Task](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/images/query.md): Query the status and result of an image generation task.
- [Query SoundClone Task](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/common/sound-clone-query.md): Poll SoundClone task status via GET /audios/{id}.
- [查询视频任务](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/common/query.md): 查询视频生成任务的状态和结果。
- [查询图片任务](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/images/query.md): 查询图片生成任务的状态和结果。
- [查询声音克隆任务](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/common/sound-clone-query.md): 查询 SoundClone 任务状态与 audioUrl。

### Account Management

- [Query User Account Balance](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/common/user-balance.md): GET /user/balance — JimiCoin account balance for the API key owner.
- [Query API Key Quota Balance](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/common/key-balance.md): GET /key/balance — per-key usage quota.
- [查询用户账户余额](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/common/user-balance.md): GET /user/balance — 查询 API Key 所属用户的吉米币账户余额。
- [查询 API Key 额度余额](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/common/key-balance.md): GET /key/balance — 查询当前 Key 的调用额度。

### Gemini Omni Video

- [Create Gemini Omni Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/gemini-omni/create.md): Create a Gemini Omni video generation task; poll the common query endpoint for results.
- [创建 Gemini Omni 视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/gemini-omni/create.md): 创建 Gemini Omni 视频生成任务，通过通用查询接口获取结果。

### MiniMax Video

- [Create Seedance 2.5 Official Channel Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/25/create.md): Create a Seedance 2.5 official-channel video task (reference images/videos/audios); billed per_second; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Seedance 2.5官链视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create.md): 创建 Seedance 2.5 官链视频任务（参考图/视频/音频），按秒计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Seedance 2.5 Official Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/25/create-gz.md): Create a Seedance 2.5 official video task; precharged then settled to actual usage; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Seedance 2.5官转视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create-gz.md): 创建 Seedance 2.5 官转视频任务，创建时预扣、成功后按实际用量多退少补，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create MiniMax H3 Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/minimax/create.md): Create a MiniMax H3 video task (reference images/audio, first/last frame); billed per_task; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 MiniMax H3 视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/minimax/create.md): 创建 MiniMax H3 视频任务（参考图/音频、首尾帧），按次计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Wan 3.0 Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/wan/create.md): Create a Wan 3.0 (`wan3.0`) video task (reference images/videos/audios); billed per_second by resolution; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Wan 3.0 视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/wan/create.md): 创建 Wan 3.0（`wan3.0`）视频任务（参考图/视频/音频），按分辨率按秒计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Wan 3.0 Official Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/wan/create-gz.md): Create a Wan 3.0 Official (`wan3.0-gz`) video task (2–30s, adaptive ratio, first/last frame, reference images/videos/audios, reference document or webpage); billed per_second via `wan3.0-gz-{resolution}`; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Wan 3.0官转视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/wan/create-gz.md): 创建 Wan 3.0 官转（`wan3.0-gz`）视频任务（2–30 秒、自适应画幅、首尾帧、参考图/视频/音频、参考文件或网页），按 `wan3.0-gz-{分辨率}` 按秒计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Wan 3.0 Official Channel Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/wan/create-gl.md): Create a Wan 3.0 Official Channel (`wan3.0-gl`) video task (2–30s, adaptive/`21:9` ratio, first/last frame, reference images/videos/audios; no file_url/link_url); prepaid per_second via `wan3.0-gl-{resolution}`, then settled to actual billed seconds; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Wan 3.0官链视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/wan/create-gl.md): 创建 Wan 3.0官链（`wan3.0-gl`）视频任务（2–30 秒、自适应/`21:9` 画幅、首尾帧、参考图/视频/音频；不支持 file_url/link_url），按 `wan3.0-gl-{分辨率}` 按秒预扣并按实际计费秒数多退少补，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Wan 3.0 Prime Official Channel Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/wan/create-prime-gl.md): Create a Wan 3.0 Prime Official Channel (`wan3.0-prime-gl`) video task (2–30s, adaptive/`21:9` ratio, first/last frame, reference images/videos/audios; no file_url/link_url); prepaid per_second via `wan3.0-prime-gl-{resolution}`, then settled to actual billed seconds; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Wan 3.0 Prime官链视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/wan/create-prime-gl.md): 创建 Wan 3.0 Prime官链（`wan3.0-prime-gl`）视频任务（2–30 秒、自适应/`21:9` 画幅、首尾帧、参考图/视频/音频；不支持 file_url/link_url），按 `wan3.0-prime-gl-{分辨率}` 按秒预扣并按实际计费秒数多退少补，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Seedance 2.0 Official Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/gz720/create.md): Create a Seedance 2.0 Official video task (`seedance2.0-gz*`; asset review; direct result URL); billed per_million_tokens; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Seedance 2.0官转视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/gz720/create.md): 创建 Seedance 2.0官转视频任务（`seedance2.0-gz*`；素材审核；结果为上游直链），按百万 token 计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。

### LLM

- [Chat Completions](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/chat/completions.md): OpenAI-compatible LLM chat (`gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, `claude-sonnet-5`); pay-as-you-go token billing with cache read/write breakdown.
- [Chat Completions](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/chat/completions.md): 兼容 OpenAI 的 LLM 对话（`gpt-5.6-sol`、`gpt-5.6-terra`、`claude-sonnet-5`）；按 token 计费，支持缓存读/写分段。
- [Probe model pricing](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/common/model-catalog.md): Public model catalog including `llm` billing models.

### Integrations

- [Codex App tutorial](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/llm/integrations/codex-app.md): Step-by-step Codex desktop app setup with screenshots.
- [Codex App 使用教程](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/llm/integrations/codex-app.md): Codex 桌面 App 逐步上手教程（含截图）。
- [Codex integration](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/llm/integrations/codex.md): Connect OpenAI Codex to ViraltokAI LLM via Responses API or CC Switch.
- [Codex 集成](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/llm/integrations/codex.md): 在 Codex 中接入 ViraltokAI LLM（Responses 直连或 CC Switch）。
- [Claude Code integration](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/llm/integrations/claude-code.md): Use Claude Code with ViraltokAI via CC Switch local routing.
- [Claude Code 集成](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/llm/integrations/claude-code.md): 通过 CC Switch 在 Claude Code 中使用 ViraltokAI LLM。

### Image Services

- [GPT Image 2 Image Generation](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/images/create.md): Create an async GPT Image 2 image task.
- [Seedream 5.0 Pro](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/images/seedream-5-0-pro/create.md): Async Seedream 5.0 Pro image generation (1K/2K, single image per request).
- [GPT Image 2 Text-to-Image](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/images/generations.md): Sync text-to-image, OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/images/generations.
- [GPT Image 2 Edit Image](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/images/edits.md): Sync image editing, OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/images/edits with multipart/form-data.
- [Understand Image](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/images/understand.md): Image understanding and analysis powered by Gemini.
- [GPT Image 2 图像生成](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/images/create.md): 创建 GPT Image 2 异步图片生成任务。
- [Seedream 5.0 Pro 图像生成](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/images/seedream-5-0-pro/create.md): Seedream 5.0 Pro 异步生图（1K/2K，每次 1 张）。
- [GPT Image 2 文生图](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/images/generations.md): 同步文生图，兼容 OpenAI POST /v1/images/generations。
- [GPT Image 2 编辑图片](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/images/edits.md): 同步图片编辑，兼容 OpenAI POST /v1/images/edits。
- [图片理解](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/images/understand.md): 基于 Gemini 的图片理解与分析。
- [Midjourney text-to-image](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/images/midjourney/create.md): Create a Midjourney Imagine task; poll GET /api/open-api/v1/images/{taskId}.
- [Midjourney follow-up actions](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/images/midjourney/actions.md): Upscale, variation, zoom, pan, inpaint, blend, describe, edits.
- [Create Midjourney image-to-video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/images/midjourney/video.md): Create a Midjourney image-to-video task; poll GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId}.
- [Midjourney 文生图](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/images/midjourney/create.md): 创建 Midjourney Imagine 任务，轮询 GET /api/open-api/v1/images/{taskId}。
- [Midjourney 二次操作](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/images/midjourney/actions.md): 放大、变体、扩图、局部重绘、融合、识图、编辑。
- [创建Midjourney 图生视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/images/midjourney/video.md): 创建 Midjourney 图生视频任务，轮询 GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId}。

### VEO Video

- [Create VEO Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/veo/create-frames.md): Create a VEO video task.
- [创建 VEO 视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/veo/create-frames.md): 创建 VEO 视频任务。

### Seedance Full Video

- [Create Seedance Full Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/create.md): Create a Full (Manxue) Seedance video task.
- [Submit Assets for Audit](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/assets-audit.md): Submit asset URLs for Seedance platform audit before use in video generation.
- [Query Assets Audit Status](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/assets-status.md): Query the audit status of submitted assets.
- [创建 Seedance 满血版视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/create.md): 创建 Seedance 满血版视频生成任务。
- [提交素材审核](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/assets-audit.md): 提交素材 URL 进行 Seedance 平台审核。
- [查询素材审核状态](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/assets-status.md): 查询已提交素材的审核状态。

### Mini版

- [Mini Create Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/mini/create.md): Create a Seedance 2.0 Mini video task (per-second billing by resolution).
- [创建Mini视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/mini/create.md): 创建 Seedance 2.0 Mini 视频任务（按分辨率按秒计费）。
- [Create Official Mini Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/mini/create-gz.md): Create an Official Mini video task (`seedance2.0-gz-mini*`; asset review; direct result URL); billed per_million_tokens; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建官链 Mini 视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/mini/create-gz.md): 创建官链 Mini 视频任务（`seedance2.0-gz-mini*`；素材审核；结果为上游直链），按百万 token 计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。

### Seedance Fast

- [Create Full Fast Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/fast/create.md): Create a Seedance Full Fast video task (`sd2_mx_fast_*`, `sd2_mx_video_fast_*`).
- [Create Full Super-Resolution SP Fast Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/fast/create-sp.md): Create a Seedance Full Super-Resolution SP Fast video task (`sd2_sp_fast_780p`, `sd2_sp_video_fast_780p`).
- [Create Seedance 2.0 Official Fast Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/fast/create-gz.md): Create a Seedance 2.0 Official Fast video task (`seedance2.0-gz-fast*`).
- [创建满血版Fast视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/fast/create.md): 创建 Seedance 满血版 Fast 视频任务（`sd2_mx_fast_*`、`sd2_mx_video_fast_*`）。
- [创建满血版超分 Fast视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/fast/create-sp.md): 创建满血版超分 Fast 视频任务（`sd2_sp_fast_780p`、`sd2_sp_video_fast_780p`）。
- [创建 Seedance 2.0官转 Fast视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/fast/create-gz.md): 创建 Seedance 2.0官转 Fast视频任务（`seedance2.0-gz-fast*`）。

### Seedance Full Super-Resolution SP

- [Create Full Super-Resolution SP Video](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/create.md): Create a Seedance Full Super-Resolution SP video task.
- [SP Upload Asset](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-upload.md): Upload assets to the Full Super-Resolution SP library.
- [SP Query Asset Detail](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-detail.md): Query a single SP asset status.
- [SP Batch Query Asset Status](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-status.md): Batch query SP asset status.
- [SP Submit Real-Person Whitelist](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/realperson-submit.md): Submit real-person portrait for whitelist processing.
- [SP Query Real-Person Status](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/realperson-status.md): Query real-person whitelist status.
- [创建满血版超分视频](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/create.md): 创建 Seedance 满血版超分视频任务。
- [SP 上传素材](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-upload.md): 上传素材到满血版超分素材库。
- [SP 查询素材详情](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-detail.md): 查询单个 SP 素材状态。
- [SP 批量查询素材状态](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-status.md): 批量查询 SP 素材状态。
- [SP 提交真人加白](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/realperson-submit.md): 提交真人图片进行加白处理。
- [SP 查询真人加白状态](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/realperson-status.md): 查询真人加白处理状态。

### SoundClone

- [Create Preview Task](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/sound-clone/clone-create.md): Submit voice-cloning preview from source audio/video URL.
- [Create Audio Task](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/sound-clone/audio-create.md): Generate production audio with modelId; billed per 10k characters plus voice fee on every submission.
- [提交试听任务](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/sound-clone/clone-create.md): 提交声音克隆试听任务。
- [提交音频生成任务](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/sound-clone/audio-create.md): 使用 modelId 生成正式音频，每次按字符 + 音色（按次）计费。

### Tools

- [Create Video Super-Resolution](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/super-resolution/create.md): Enhance a public video to higher resolution/FPS; poll common video query.
- [创建视频超分任务](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/super-resolution/create.md): 将公网视频增强为更高清结果，通过通用视频查询接口轮询。
- [Create Remove-Subtitle Task](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/remove-subtitle/create.md): Remove burned-in subtitles from a public video; poll common video query.
- [创建去字幕任务](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/remove-subtitle/create.md): 去除公网视频画面字幕，通过通用视频查询接口轮询。
- [Create Video-Translate Task](https://docs.viraltok.ai/en/api-reference/video-translate/create.md): Translate spoken video into a target language; poll common video query; optional caption_url.
- [创建视频翻译任务](https://docs.viraltok.ai/zh/api-reference/video-translate/create.md): 将源视频口播翻译到目标语言，通过通用视频查询接口轮询；可选 caption_url。
